errors.text: The proposed Mo addition does not reconstruct the target intervention of spark plasma sintering MgAlTiVFeCo at 1000 °C.
No alloy composition, Mo concentration, processing window, oxidation temperature, or corrosion medium is specified.
The claim that Mo reduces intermetallic formation conflicts with cited evidence stating that Mo promotes hard intermetallic phases.
The proposed mechanism omits densification and the uniformly distributed AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 barrier phases central to the target mechanism.
The experiment does not test mechanical performance despite claiming combined mechanical, corrosion, and oxidation improvement.
